bio: La Bankada is situated close to the market in the Ensanche district of the city, where it boasts a relaxed, easy-going ambience enhanced by its three outgoing owners. It is particularly popular with a local clientele attracted to dishes such as the Russian salad (ensaladilla), the ever-in-demand tacos, and the delicious potato omelette with free-range eggs. Unsurprising, La Bankada is always full....
